Qualification repair round 3 (operator-authorized, bounded): fixture-only repairs of the three demonstrated round-2 causes. (1) Failure diagnostics: RuntimeLease capture_container now retains the redacted launch command, container state/exit status, and the health-probe result alongside the container logs before any cleanup, in both the health-failure and finally paths. (2) Credential runtime startup: atomic config replacement (stage+fsync+os.replace) with a directory mount so a (re)starting process cannot observe a partial config - round-2 root cause was a restarted runtime reading EOF mid-string at column 1355 of a valid 1458-byte config written in place. (3) PostgreSQL recovery backend: provision the pinned Supabase image per its designed bootstrap identity (POSTGRES_USER=supabase_admin; migrate.sh then creates the postgres role with the same password) and require durable readiness plus host TCP reachability through the published endpoint before the backend is consumed - round-2 root cause was migrate.sh FATAL on missing supabase_admin -> container exit 2 -> bindings torn down -> 'no public port'. Pinned image digest kept; product source unchanged.

Qualification repair round 4 (fixture-only): (1) local-backend store verification authenticates as the credential the SurrealKV store was initialized with (product defaults root/root), correcting the temp-host auth identity that caused POST /sql 401; (2) content-versioned config filenames (config-<sha12>.json, atomic stage+fsync+os.replace) with recreate-on-config-change, eliminating the transient stale file-view class; startup retries removed and every failure records intended-vs-visible config hashes.

Qualification repair round 6 (concurrent replay defect): the Surreal persistent migrate_legacy lacked the post-collision journal-replay fallback its Postgres counterpart has (ON CONFLICT loser -> replay of the winner's immutable receipt). Racing identical If-Match requests both passed preflight and collided on the journal CREATE, surfacing 503 credential_migration_unavailable. The Surreal loser path now re-reads the journal and replays it (authorization and preconditions revalidated; typed rejections keep priority; no retries, no serialized concurrency). Fixture permanently captures bounded redacted error codes on HTTP failures (Http._error_code).
